title: Remote Operation, Webcam Monitoring, and Troubleshooting
description: Launching prints via web interface, live webcam stream monitoring, remote emergency actions, and post-processing ABS parts.
objectives: Start G-code printing remotely via web interface
Monitor first-layer adhesion through live webcam feed
Perform emergency pause or cancel operations from your browser
Diagnose and prevent Warping and Layer Splitting remotely

steps.title: Remote Print Start
steps.description: Triggering the print from the browser UI.
details: On the GTMAX web dashboard, select the uploaded G-code file from the list

steps.title: Real-Time Webcam Monitoring
steps.description: Stream inspection without opening the machine door.
details: Open the 'Webcam' tab on your browser dashboard
Watch the first Brim lines being deposited on the bed
Ensure plastic adheres firmly without lifting at corners

steps.title: Remote Pause and Cancellation
details: If warping is spotted on the webcam, click 'Cancel Print' on the web UI
For material swap or quick check, click 'Pause Print'

steps.title: Cooling and Part Removal
steps.description: Safe removal of finished ABS parts.
details: Wait for bed temperature to drop below 50°C on the web temperature chart
Open the acrylic door on the GTMAX
Remove part using the spatula and peel off Brim manually

troubleshooting.problem: Webcam feed is frozen or lagging
solutions: Refresh webcam tab in your browser
Check printer Wi-Fi connection strength to local network router

troubleshooting.problem: Part warps off the bed during printing
solutions: Cancel print using web UI button
Increase Brim width in PrusaSlicer and verify bed reached 100°C prior to starting
